archived.description: Boolean flag used to determine if the account is archived.

code.description: Account code or number used in the accounting system's chart of accounts.

companyId.description: Pleo's internal identifier of the company the account is associated with.

externalId.description:
Unique external identifier of account, assigned in the external ERP/accounting system. 
            Can be the same as code if no other identifier is available.

id.description: Pleo's internal identifier of the account.

additionalProperties.description: Place for API users to store flexible data.

metadata.description: Place for API users to store flexible data.

taxCodeExternalId.description: The identifier in **the target system** for the tax code the account is associated with.
